title: Benchmarking Boltz-2 for relative kinase-inhibitor interaction patterns across conformational states and resistance mutations.
one_liner_zh: 该文系统评估生成式结构预测模型Boltz-2在激酶-抑制剂复合物上的预测能力，涉及蛋白-配体结构预测与构象状态，虽为基准测试而非方法创新，但聚焦蛋白质结构计算问题并具实用参考价值。
abstract: Generative structure-prediction models can directly predict protein-ligand complexes from sequence and ligand information, but their ability to capture pharmacologically relevant kinase-inhibitor interactions remains incompletely understood. We systematically evaluated Boltz-2 using curated biochemical IC(50) measurements across eight human kinases, nine clinically used inhibitors, and representative resistance mutations. Although predicted log(10)(IC(50)) values showed a compressed dynamic range relative to experimental measurements, mutation-dependent shifts in inhibitor sensitivity, inhibitor selectivity patterns, and overall potency rankings showed substantial agreement with the experimental patterns within the present benchmark. Predicted binding probability showed good discrimination between binder and non-binder pairs within the present benchmark and a consistent inverse relationship with experimental potency. Structural analyses showed that ligand-pose variability was associated with prediction behavior within the evaluated kinase-inhibitor systems, even when kinase-domain structures showed close agreement with the corresponding experimental structures. Larger ligand RMSD values were not associated with larger prediction errors in magnitude, but were linked to systematic shifts in prediction bias, indicating that ligand-pose accuracy and predictive utility are not equivalent measures of Boltz-2 performance. These findings suggest that, within the present benchmark, relative kinase-inhibitor interaction patterns were reproduced more consistently than absolute potency values. We provide a framework for interpreting Boltz-2 outputs within the kinase-inhibitor systems examined here.
abstract_zh: 生成式结构预测模型能够直接从序列和配体信息预测蛋白质-配体复合物，但其捕捉药理学相关激酶-抑制剂相互作用的能力仍未完全明了。我们使用精选的生化学IC(50)测量数据，对八种人类激酶、九种临床使用抑制剂及代表性耐药突变进行了系统性评估。尽管预测的log(10)(IC(50))值相对于实验测量显示出压缩的动态范围，但突变依赖性抑制剂敏感性变化、抑制剂选择性模式以及总体效力排名，在本基准内与实验模式表现出显著一致性。预测的结合概率在本基准内对结合对和非结合对显示出良好的区分能力，并与实验效力呈一致的负相关关系。结构分析表明，在所评估的激酶-抑制剂系统中，配体姿态变异性与预测行为相关，即使激酶域结构与相应实验结构高度一致。较大的配体RMSD值并未与更大的预测误差幅度相关联，但导致了预测偏差的系统性变化，表明配体姿态准确性和预测实用性并非Boltz-2性能的等效衡量指标。这些发现表明，在本基准内，相对激酶-抑制剂相互作用模式比绝对效力值更一致地被重现。我们提供了一个框架，用于解释此处所检查的激酶-抑制剂系统中Boltz-2的输出结果。
